gold_query: SELECT T1.cylinders FROM CARS_DATA AS T1 JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.MakeId WHERE T2.Model = 'volvo' ORDER BY T1.accelerate ASC LIMIT 1
